t: Meet with the Spirit of Competition and give him Squall's message.

Now it's time to answer Fiercetusk's ultimatum. You know, we shamans rule because we don't just throw ourselves onto the battlefield. We choose the moment we fight, and we do so on our terms. Can you see the difference?
My answer will be that of a civilized Imperial Orc.
There is a stadium between Izune and the Astral Quarter. It will become an arena for battle between the shamans and the warriors. And no, it won't be Goblinball! It will be an honest battle.
Go to the stadium and talk to the Spirit of Competition. Only he is trustworthy enough to judge the competition. Everything will be fair!
I assume you would like to participate. You can tell the Spirit which side you choose to fight for, but I strongly recommend you fight for the shamans!

So, Squall accepted Fiercetusk's challenge? Great! That means we've got a fight on our hands!
Do you want to take part? Then pick a side to fight for. Which do you prefer - the simple, steadfast, and direct warriors, or the crafty, cunning, and clever shamans?
Return the Holy Relic to Strongaxe the Righteous.

Hey, wait a second! I can see by your clothes that you aren't one of the local ragamuffins. I need help.

You probably haven't seen a lot of Orcs like me, eh? Orc Paladins! The Punishers!

Yes, we carry the power of the Light of the Trinity Church. Unfortunately, most of my brothers are nowhere close to understanding it, so they look at me funny. It's just a matter of time until they change their ways, though. I plan to build a church in this area to speed up the process.

The only problem is that I need an artifact imbued with the Light to lay in the temple's foundation. I had one earlier today, but it disappeared! It's a fragment of the Headlong, an Astral ship that sank at the Battle of the June Portal. It was this very ship that thwarted the attack of the ruthless octulhu while Nezeb and Skrakan tried to close the portal. Do you understand how sacred that artifact is? And it disappeared!

I think it must have been stolen by some of the unenlightened orcs in the area. When they saw me, they yelled that they would not allow a church to be built here, and they called me all sorts of names. I'm sure they were the ones who stole the relic. I'm ordering you to recover the relic. This is a very important holy mission! Don't let me down.

Now, where to find them... I'm afraid I can't tell you the exact location of those fools - you'll have to search around the Astral Quarter.
Ah, there is still much to do before the Light of the Trinity Church penetrates the hearts of my fellow tribesman!
Yes, that's it! Thank Nezeb it's back! Now the temple can be built! You deserve a reward. But remember, spreading the Light is more important than these trinkets.
Go to Yasker's Tower and speak with the Keeper of Secrets, Mark Staritsyn.

Now I recommend that you visit Yasker's Tower and speak with Mark Staritsyn.
Why? Well, he is the Keeper of Secrets, and it's his job to gather data about all of the world's mysteries and curiosities. I think our recent discovery falls under this category. We just learned how to use the power of the ancient June ruins for our own purposes! I'm sure that Mark will be interested in your story. Perhaps he'll even reward you.

Yes, I collect secrets and the information you brought to me is both extremely interesting and important. If you out about any more mysteries in the future, remember to pay me a visit. I'll make it worth your while.
As for this secret, I believe that the fact that you can use ancient June ruins for your own needs is reward enough. Well, until next time...
Kill 4 League Stalkers in the League Camp to the southeast of the Boiler Camp. Report to Oko the Righteous.

I must admit, the attack on the XAES was well-coordinated. We'll have to work hard to disrupt the League's plans.
Our scouts report that there's a small camp of League Saboteurs in the southeastern corner of the Boiler Camp. It's guarded by groups of Gibberlings. I'm sure these fluffy creatures are ruthless killers!
I'm tasking you with breaking into the camp and dealing with the enemy. Eliminate 4 groups of them! But be careful! The Gibberlings might look small and harmless, but don't let that fool you. They are dangerous fiends!
Have the menaces been dealt with yet?
Ha! That will teach them to mess with the Empire! Now I won't have to replace my scouts quite so often. Thank you for your help.
Help eliminate the League Officers in their camp. Report to Oko the Righteous.

We've received reports that the League has three main leaders in charge of the forces at the Boiler Camp. According to the reports, they are junior officers of the League Army. Senior officers are probably at the XAES... Still, taking them out would surely deliver a crushing blow!
So here's your task. Sneak into the League Camp and take out one of these officers. They're bound to be heavily guarded, so I suggest you find a couple of friends to go with you. When you're done, come back here.
I trust that you're taking care of the issue? You do realize how important this mission is to the success of our operation, right?
Success! I can feel it now... victory is within our grasp. It won't be too long until the League menace is purged from our city!
Participate in killing Andrey Chikatilin and report to Anna Kovalchina.

We're in over our heads!

It's only me and my partner here. We're cadets from the Nezebgrad Police Academy, and we were just patrolling the area when a woman ran out of this door. She was covered in blood, with a crazed look in her eyes! She was lucky to escape the hands of the maniac in there. Haven't you heard? The mutilated bodies of women have been showing up around town lately. There were tons of theories about whoever was behind it! Gangs of vicious Gibberlings, Astral demons... Finally, the truth has come out. Apparently there's a mad Xadaganian in there. Where do these freaks come from?!

My partner and I wanted to apprehend the bastard. We entered the apartment, and then... we ran away. He's too dangerous.

Unfortunately, there's no one who can help us catch the guy. There's some kind of emergency, so everyone is busy dealing with the consequences. We don't know what happened, but I hear it's something dreadful. For now we're just standing here shaking with fear. What happens if this maniac pounces on us and then keeps on roaming the streets killing civilians?

We must stop him. Maybe you can help us out?
This maniac is responsible for the deaths of many women! He must be brought to justice!
Well, I suppose that taking him alive wasn't an option. Good work! Now we can tell the police they have one less case to solve.
Participate in killing the Black Lord and report back to Dubi the Dirty.

You know that we goblins also dream of becoming full-fledged citizens of the Empire. What makes us lower than the Orcs? We have two arms, two legs, and a head just like they do!
At the moment we're made to do the duties no one else wants to do... cleaning, painting, sweeping the streets. And you know why they've gotten away with this? Most goblins are too uneducated to complain.
The ones that do rebel against the system usually turn to crime. The other Imperial races use this fact to claim that we will never be able to be "productive members of society".
Have you ever heard about the goblin nicknamed the Black Lord? He's a vicious one. Even all of the other goblins are afraid of him. He commands all of the goblin criminals in town. His lair is located in the mountains to the west of Nezebgrad. Right now I bet he's planning more horrible things that make us all look bad!...
You think you can kill him? Ha! You'd best be careful if you want to pull that off. But if you could, myself and other goblins like me would be eternally grateful.
If you kill the Black Lord things will be so much better for the goblin race as a whole.

Hurray! The Black Lord is dead! I'm going to write a letter to the City Council telling them that goblins are starting to walk the path of good. I'm sure that goblin emancipation is just around the corner!
Speak with the auctioneer in Yasker's Tower.

Attention, attention!
The Nezebgrad auction house is proud to inform citizens of the Empire that a new record has been set! Yesterday one million different lots were successfully sold! In facilitating the exchange of goods between citizens, the auction house is constantly doing its best to raise the quality of life within the Empire!
Have you been to the auction house yet? I highly recommend it! I would almost say it's your duty as a citizen! You'd best speak to an auctioneer about how the auction house works. It's their job to explain that kind of thing.
So you want to learn how the auction house works? I can tell you everything about it!
Speak with Grigory Gubin in Yasker's Tower.

Attention, attention!
The doors of the Nezebgrad Bank are open to all citizens of the Empire! Now everyone can have a place to store their valuables. The Empire guarantees the security of all items stored with the Nezebgrad Bank, so go visit it today!
You know, I haven't had a moment's trouble since the bank opened. Now I don't have to worry about my stuff getting stolen or damaged. I used to think it was better to throw things away than be tormented by the anguish of such possibilities. But the Bank is an excellent solution to those problems!
Best of all, the employees are all so polite and willing to answer any questions! Don't believe me? Go and see for yourself. It's on the first floor of Yasker's Tower.
Welcome to the Nezebgrad Bank! How can I help you? Shall I outline how things work around here? It's really quite simple!
Talk to Yuri Kopeykin at the Yasker's Tower.
Do you want to trade gold for Crystals, or vice versa? I'll explain you how.
Speak with Guild Master Semer Khendjer in Yasker's Tower.

Attention, attention!
According to the report of the Guild Master Semer Khendjer, the most popular words when choosing a guild name in the last 3 months have been Blood, Revenge and Death. The Propaganda Directorate of the City Council urges Imperial citizens to use softer and kinder words when registering the guilds. Good examples of more peaceful guild names include "Warm Sun" and "Dancing with the Wind".
Are you a member of a guild? If you're not, definitely join one or. You should talk to Semer Khendjer to start your own. He's in charge of registering guilds. Let me remind you of the propaganda department's request again - no names like "The Deadly Avengers"!
If you wish to register a new guild then you should listen to my instructions first. It's quite easy, I assure you.
Meet with the scientist Sarang Ahmes at the ZIT Headquarters.

Attention, attention!
The ZIT Headquarters is requesting volunteers to participate in a study on the Twelve Great Martyrs. I highly encourage all citizens of the Empire to assist the ZIT scientists. Please speak with Sarang Ahmes at the ZIT Headquarters for additional information.
I repeat...
Hello. Would you like to participate in our experiments on the powers of the Twelve Great Martyrs?
Bring one "For" token and one "Against" token to the Nezebgrad Guide. They are located in the Boutique which can be accessed from the icon in the bottom left-hand corner of the interface.

Attention, attention!
This week the citizens of the Empire are allowed to vote on all of the latest laws that the officials of our great country has proposed. Get yourself to the polls and voice your opinion! Remember that only citizens that are registered will be allowed to cast their votes.
What, you aren't registered? I'm sorry to say that it takes about seven to eight weeks for the registration to be processed. Well, since you can't help the Empire by voicing your opinion, you can do one other thing. I'm embarrassed to say it, but we're almost out of voting tokens! If you could go get me a couple, you'd be doing your part to help this great country, I assure you! Where do you get them? Why, in the Boutique of course! In the "Services" category, you will see "Ballots" shelf. Buying votes won't cost you anything.
Thank you for bringing the tokens to me. The voice of the people is always important!
Go to Municipality and meet Valeria Commissarina.

Attention, attention!
As the Great Yasker wrote in his decree to establish new strong units of society - families - our Municipality, where you can register a legal marriage, is open. You will find Valery Comissarina, who can legitimate your relationships with your chosen one, by the Auction.
I repeat...

Greetings to you!
If you want to register a legal marriage, welcome to our municipality.
Talk to the Mercenary Captain Alexandra Soldina in the Astral Academy.
If you have not yet found loyal comrades-in-arms who could help you through group instances, you can use the mercenaries. Alexandra Soldina will tell you more about them.
An hour in combat, a week in the taverns! As they say, it's either a feast or a famine!

In short, if you are facing a fierce battle and you can't find any comrades to watch your back, then you can pay us and we will solve all your problems in a flash. And to show that these are not just empty words, we will perform the first contract free of charge!
Use the Mercenary Contract spell from your spellbook to summon the Mercenary Captain while having a Free Mercenary Contract with you and being in a group adventure.

No, I am not joking! These days nobody takes you at your word. But you know, we value our reputation as the best mercenary squad more than gold. And so, exclusively to show our ability to resolve any problems in return for adequate payment, my mercenaries are prepared to work for you once for free. When you encounter the need to travel to somewhere where you cannot go alone, remember my words. You already know the special spell that will allow you to summon me at any moment. So, don't be shy about using it if you need to! And remember - the first time we will help you completely free of charge. When you see how my boys deal with your enemies, you will be back again to avail of their services, you'll see!
I think that you are faced with a dangerous adventure. And where there's danger, there is gold!

What, is it time for my boys to show what they are capable of? Well, choose who you want, and off you go to crush the enemy! But I will take this free contract from you, and the next time our help will cost you a few gold coins.
Find the Profession Book and return it to Yuri Pronin.

How cruel life is! I'm a Xadaganian, the son of the great Empire, and here I am sitting hat in hand at the square! You want to know how I managed to sink so low? I'll tell you.
I wanted to become a master of a profession. I spent a lot of time choosing the right job and when I finally made my decision, I asked one of the Imperial artisans to take me as an apprentice.
They gave me a warm welcome and then I did the most important thing of all - I bought the training book. But I didn't get to read it! It got stolen! And I was left without any money to buy another one.
That's how I ended up with nothing... I wish I could find that thief! I'm sure he's somewhere around here - he's probably one of those black hyenas! Oh, how I want my book back! I'd get back to my studies and earn a fortune in a second!
Ahh... Where are you, my little book... life in this world is hard without a profession...

Oh! This is it! You found it! I'm saved!
Thank you!
I hope my story taught you a lesson! Choose your profession wisely and keep your book safe! Getting a second chance to become a Master costs a fortune!
Activate your patron's rune and show your results to Semer Nemar.

It's time to begin your rune training.
The first lesson is learning how to activate a rune. It'll grant you additional powers, because this is a rune of your Patron. It's a simple task, so I'm sure you'll be able to do it, providing that you're not an idiot.
Have you completed the task yet?
Good work, your first lesson is complete. Here's your reward. Visit the Boutique now, and then come back for your next lesson.
Use the Rune Welder to combine 2 runes in your bag and report to the Semer Nemar.

The next lesson is about combining runes. For this lesson you will need to purchase the Rune Welder from my shop to combine two runes using gold dust and crystal chips. And as I'm sure you're already aware, I've rewarded you with the crystal chips and gold dust from our second lesson.
Use you rune welder to fuse two runes together to create a more powerful one. But remember to unpack your crystal chips. Go on, it's simple, really.
Did you fail your first attempt? Play around with it more, it isn't too hard.
Now that wasn't so hard was it? Good work, your lesson is now complete.
Speak with Yaver Yevgini at the Astral Academy.

Attention, attention!
Now every Imperial citizen can conquer the Astral! "An individual's power to shape the world is endless. Each person must be allowed to reach their full potential." That is what Yasker himself said as he signed the order allowing anyone to build their own Astral ship!
Now you too can venture into the unknown and leave your footprints on distant allods! Instructions for building an Astral ship can be obtained from the Imperial Astral Academy. Simply speak to Yaver Yevgini, the Ship Master, to begin the process today!
Ah, another conqueror of the Astral. So, you want to build your own ship? That's possible but it won't happen instantly.
Take the ship from the Nezebgrad Port to Asee-Teph and give Bugailo the Unyielding the Valuable Package.

Attention, attention!
Regular voyages to the Holy Land are now available to all citizens! All those willing to join in the fight against the League are welcome to leave for Asee-Teph by boarding an Astral ship at the port. The Imperial Army needs you! Follow in the footsteps of Major Bugailo the Unyielding who personally eliminated several hundred League soldiers!
By the way, Major Bugailo has been awarded a Medal of Courage by special order of Yasker himself. And guess what, the mission of delivering the Major's award has been assigned to the famous Imperial Survivor! Take this. It's a very important package, so please hand it to Bugailo personally.
Well, what do you need? This isn't the kind of place to engage in idle chatter.

What? A Medal of Courage? For me? Wow... That's so nice! Thank you. Huh, I guess the government knows about me and appreciates my deeds. Well, I'll be... Now I'll take on the whole League myself, argh!
Collect 100 Astral Azurites, 80 Astral Chrysolites and 60 Astral Topazes to get a Ruby. Report to Elizaveta Rysina.

According to the Laws of the Empire, each citizen has the right not only to work, but to rest! You are working alright, but when are you going to vacations? I think it's high time for you to visit Tropical Atoll!
Find Zouzou "Seven Steps" to travel there.
Welcome to the best allod of Sarnaut! Let's celebrate your vacation!
Talk to Travel Agent in Nezebrad.

By decree of the Great Yasker all Imperial citizens willing to have a rest from their hard work are allowed to travel to the Tropical Atoll, a holiday resort recently opened for visitors. Travel agents in Nezebrad will tell you the details. All visitors of the resort are required to have their passports, bathing suits and a good mood!
Hello! Do you want to have a holiday? Ask me if you want to learn more of the Tropical Atoll.
This strange trunk is sitting in the middle of Victory Park. I wonder whose it is and what's inside. Maybe you should take a look. What's the harm in that?
Interesting, it looks like there are a few nice gifts inside! This was probably owned by hoodlums anyway, so you should take it for yourself!
Find the hidden treasure to the south and report your success to Squall the Unyielding.

Alright, I'll tell you this: as a shaman and the clan leader, I have to deal with all sort of things, some of them ridiculous.

Like this one time, for example... A Xadaganian shows up, complaining that my guys stole a chest from him. It turns out that he was... Obsessed with Nezeb. I mean, he is so devoted to Nezeb that he keeps making offerings to him. Not bloody or anything, just... stuff. And his memory is failing... So he forgot where he left his chest with offerings, so he started accusing my guys. But we sorted that out...

Except we never found that chest. I bet it's still near some memorial. I'd start with the Victory Park, the demon memorial is the most striking of those. But I have no time for that...
So this is what Squall was talking about? Interesting...
Take the New Issue of "Prick Ears" to Pavel Bogdanov.
This magazine is free of wrinkles and tears and is much newer than the other samples discovered on the smugglers. This might be some great evidence for Bogdanov's investigation!
The morality of the whole town is at risk! No, not just of the town... of the whole Empire!

Another magazine? Hand it over!
I... I'll add this to the case file immediately and send it over to the City Council. And of course I won't open it!
Oh, I'll mention your work on this mission as well. Good job Imperial Survivor.
Disperse 20 lost souls in IMD and report to Yulia Dobrynina in Nezebgrad.

Greetings, hero. Hold on a minute! I would like to entrust you with a very important job. Perhaps it's not as dangerous or glorious as your usual heroic deeds, but believe me, it's just as prestigious.
Have you met any lost souls yet? Poor creatures, doomed to forever walk in the world which doesn't welcome them any more... They would like to die, but they can't. Our sacred duty, the duty of anyone who believes in the Light is to give them peace.
There are many lost souls in the Igsh Military District, left behind after the recent battles. I beg you, please disperse them, lay them to rest and put an end to their torture. You will be handsomely rewarded! You will receive Tears of the Dragon and a Shard of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon as a reward!
It's our sacred duty to bring peace to restless souls!

May your path be blessed by the Light, my child
A righteous deed never goes unnoticed. Take these Tears of the Dragon. You will find them useful in your adventures. This is a shard of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon. If you manage to collect enough shards to get a Frozen Tear, you will never have to worry about replenishing your Tears supply again.
Go to the Purgatory by drinking instant poison, dispense mirra to the dead you find there, and report to Yulia Dobrynina in Nezebgrad.

Mercy towards the fallen is the best virtue!
When the Light came into this world, death stopped being the end of life but merely a quick breather. Purgatory is not exactly a place where I'd want to spend my free time. But you already knew that, right? Everyone knows that heroes are frequent visitors to Purgatory! Which isn't exactly the case for the rest of us. For the little people, every minute in Purgatory is a terrible torture! However, we can ease their pain by showing mercy. I hope that you will be able to help me with this hard task.
I will give you poison. If you drink it, you will go directly to the world beyond. I will also give you mirra - it will help you to come back here. And not just you! Share your mirra with anyone who has been stuck in Purgatory for a long time, regardless of whether they serve the Empire or the League. Help the sufferers to come back to life and your mercy will return to you a hundredfold! You will receive Tears of the Dragon and a Shard of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon as a reward!
Our faith is built on mercy!

May your path be blessed by the Light, my child! A righteous deed never goes unnoticed. Take these Tears of the Dragon. You will find them useful in your adventures. This is a Shard of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon. If you manage to collect enough shards to get a Frozen Tear, you will never have to worry about replenishing your Tears supply again.
Hello, hero! Do you know how much longer I'm going to be stuck here? I realize now that I love life more than the peaceful calamity of the Afterlife...
Repel the invasion of demons to the Cradle and report to Yulia Dobrynina in Nezebgrad.

I have a task for you. You're the one to deal with the invasion of demonic creatures... What creatures? The ones attacking the Cradle. It seems that the demons are trying to destroy the portal that leads to the Dead City! I don't know what they are after, but I am sure that it heralds trouble for us. So, if you hate demons as much as I do, then please gather your friends, go to the Cradle, lure out the demons that are circling around it and destroy as many of these astral fiends as you can! You will receive Tears of the Dragon and a Shard of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon as a reward!
Demons are the scourge of our world. We fight them everywhere, but it doesn't seem to make even a dent in their numbers...

May your path be blessed by the Light, my child! A righteous deed never goes unnoticed. Take these Tears of the Dragon. You will find them useful in your adventures. This is a Shard of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon. If you manage to collect enough shards to get a Frozen Tear, you will never have to worry about replenishing your Tears supply again.
Complete seven Yulia Dobrynina's quests to receive your reward.

Hello, comrade. I studied the non-classified part of your personal file, and I can see you are always willing to help the Trinity Church. This is good.

Here's the situation. On the one hand, demons are attacking different places all over the world. On the other hand, there are various situations that require the interference of our armed forces. What's the result of it? First, wandering souls appear here and there. Second, our best soldiers and innocent citizens are stuck in the Purgatory in great numbers. Third, demons are completely out of control!

I will give you one quest a day. Complete seven quests, and I will give you a good rewards - shards of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon. Is it good enough?

Shall we start?
The faster you finish, the sooner I will leave you alone.

All done right on the schedule. Nice to do business with you, comrade. Make sure to come by next week. We've got enough to keep you busy.

Here's your rewards - shards of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon. You may combine them and receive a great tool for fighting the enemies of Sarnaut.
Confirm that you've understood everything about the Recruit's Chest.

Recruit's Chest is a special item used for improving your gear. Open it to receive a new piece of equipment useful for your class and level that can replace the most outdated of your items.
If your equipment is good enough for your level, you will receive gold instead of item, the amount depends on your level.
Recruit's Chests are given away automatically as you complete quests

If you already have a Recruit's Chest, open it to receive your reward. If you don't, complete more quests.
And remember - sharing and completing quests together is fun and profitable!
Complete three quests from Bloom the Vernal and Rosie Oubliepas.

As you can see, we have quite a lot of tasks! To stimulate our volunteers, the Spring Committee has created a pool of rewards for them. Cut short, if you keep helping us, we'll thank you with the Gifts of Spring!
I wonder who else may help me with the manure... Will you? No? Why not?
Well done! Imperial style! Carry on the good job! Happy spring, comrade!
Collect a bouquet of 5 flowers and give it to another player character.

Normally, it is strictly prohibited to walk on flowerbeds and pick up flowers. But I'll tell you a secret: these flowerbeds are not common flowerbed that you come across every day. It's the Spring magic working, so feel free to pick as many flowers as you need! Then find someone who hasn't been greeted yet, and give them bunches of flowers! Everybody must be happy. That's an order.
It's been so many years that I have not received flowers for the Spring day...
Another Imperial citizen is congratulated! Keep up the good job!
Teleport to IMD and speak to Rosie Oubliepas and Bloom the Vernal.

Merry Spring to you! On these days we commemorate the Imperial Keepers, brave men and women, who gave their lives for the Empire. We honor all homefront workers, who boldly supported our soldiers in the days of need. Do you want to help organize the celebration? We're always in need of volunteers.

This year we have chosen Igsh Military District to host the celebrations. Go there and find Committee officials, Bloom the Vernal and Rosie Oubliepas. They surely have a job for you.
These volunteers are so back and forth these days! They do three or four tasks and just flee!
Let's do it! If we want to have real fun, we must work on it!

See, what kind of nature we have got here? Dry flat land, dusty and windy, dead herbage... I’ve always wanted a green lawn and a flowerbed. Now that I’m a Spring committee officer, I can plant grass and flowers all around, and you will assist!

Here are the grass seeds, enchanted by our best shamans. They will bloom wherever you plant them, even on dry sand. However, they won’t grow anywhere outside Igsh Military District, but we can at least beautify this sad place!
Yasker is a Great Mage! Why would he tolerate this dull and gloomy landscape around the capital? For the sake of Xadaganian history?
Nice! Another fifteen hundred of flowerbeds will give the military district a totally new look!
Deliver 5 Draft Cards to Deserters and report to Bloom the Vernal.

You might be surprised if I tell you that not everyone rejoices when spring comes. There are certain young men of legal age that dodge the draft! Fancy that! They are unwilling to join our brave army! Here are the draft cards. Find the rambling youngsters and hand them the cards.
I was happy to enroll for army! Look at the young people today! Are they capable of defending the motherland at all?
Ready? Well done! It serves them well. Army is good for them!
Speak to Ukhvat the Rowdy, Evgeny Mogilin and Sino the Merciless. Report to Bloom the Vernal.

No organization without control! It's a strict rule. We need to keep records and distribute effort! I ask you to fetch the latest data from the Spring Committee officers: Ukhvat the Rowdy, Evgeny Mogilin and Sino the Merciless. Thank you and off you go!
That was right on the schedule, thank you!
Approve Crazystorm to help Womens celebration.

I'm telling you once, listen carefully.
100 years ago was the first invasion of the demons. Night of Astral Portals. War everywhere. Many of ours were killed, allods diminished, but the demons was beaten by our ancestors .
Then Imperial Sentinels arose, which I am now in command of. Since it's such a holiday, we decided to make this day special. In memory of fallen ancestors and their exploits, and all that.
But, damnit, for some reason they decided to make it a male only holiday. As the Great Yasker: "There was unfortunate mistake which must be corrected!"
That's what we are going to do now. Congratulate the women.
Will you help?
Defeat a Kanian, an Elf and a Gibberling family, then talk to Crazystorm.

Defender of the Motherland! Nice, huh? Such a title!
But don't forget that real men find their fun in battles. Time to kick League's ass! Defeat a Kanian, an Elf and a Gibberling family to celebrate the holiday!
Having the confidence of the Spring Committee, you can buy very useful things.

Aha! Had your fun?
That's it! We Defenders of Motherland must keep ourselves in shape. What if there is war tomorrow?
Give a greeting cards to a three women of the Empire.

That's what we do for greeting women.
Give them greeting cards! With beautiful words about, how they are beautiful, how we love them and all that. Look! Do you see that? "I wish you love as strong as an Orc hug!" I just made it up.
I should give three cards. Each women who gets this card becomes the "Chosen". That means a great confidence and it will be easier for her to earn a reputation.
Come back when you complete this task, and I can give you another one.
And more. In carrying out these tasks, you can increase your reputation with the "Spring Committee." It was established recently, specifically for these holidays.

They say that women love with their ears.In the sense that they like to hear all the compliments.
Hmm, maybe, maybe...

Well done!
Now let's do something else.
Yes, almost forgot! Have a look at the Old Square for Martha Convolutina. She as well has a holiday mission for you.
Give a red roses to three women of the Empire.

That's what we do for greeting women.
We give them roses! Dogrose the Forester advised me. She says that the rose is a symbol of love. And there's nothing for women nicer than a flower. For women, it means that she has male attention. That she is loved and appreciated.
So take three roses. Look for women that you love and appreciate. Do you have any?
Come back when you complete this task, and I'll give you another one.
And more. In carrying out these tasks, you can increase your reputation with the "Spring Committee." It was established recently, specifically for these holidays.
Roses are for women! Do not mess up!

Well done!
Now let's do something else.
Yes, almost forgot! Have a look at the Old Square for Martha Convolutina. She as well has holiday mission for you.
Give invitations for three women of the Empire.

That's what we do for greeting women.
Gifts! Any valuable and sweet things. As the time passes, the woman sees this gift and remembers about the holiday and about who gave it to her, she will feel good. Well, I think so.
So here are three invitations. Give them to three women, let them come to the Spring Committee, and choose a gift from a special trunk.
Come back when you complete this task, and I'll give you another one.
And more. In carrying out these tasks, you can increase your reputation with the "Spring Committee." It was established recently, specifically for these holidays.

Yasker allocated a separate item in the budget for filling up this trunk with presents .
And he said that he had never been so happy, signing financial documents.

Excellent!
I have another task. Can you help?
Yes, almost forgot! Have a look at the Old Square for Martha Convolutina. She as well has a holiday mission for you.
Drink ten light ginger beers, preserving your state unchanged, and report about the victory to Martha Convolutina.

Hello.
Also wonder about what is going on here?
It's all Storm invented. He said that it is a men's holiday and we should organize men's fun. He decided this task in his own way. Like Orc.
Essence is simple fun. It is necessary to drink 10 cups in a row of light ginger beer and stay sober. Honestly, not many can do this.
You can participate only once a day. Rysina has made adjustments to the plan of celebration. I think you understand why.
Well, you will demonstrate male prowess?
If you can do this task, you increase your reputation with the "Spring Committee".
I offered to include in the competition a test of a new combat cocktail. Not allowed...

Wow! Yes you can!
I mean it's cool that the critical loads so little impact on your body.
Not many can boast of such. And to be honest... It's very, very... exciting...
Agree to Crazystorm to help in honoring men.

Yeah, you're here, then we can talk.
Listen carefully, other way i will forget everything. For me, all these historical things- dark forest.
Short story, 100 years ago was the first invasion of demons. Night of Astral Portals. War everywhere. Many ours were killed, allods diminished, but the demons was beaten by our ancestors.
Than Imperial Sentinels, which I am now in command of. And once it's such a holiday, decided to make this day special in memory of fallen ancestors, their feats and all that.
short! We congratulate the men of the Empire. Those who stand on guard for peace, prosperity and... damn... It...Clean Astral!
Will you help?
I have a number of tasks. If you are ready to help - agree!

Well.
I knew I could trust you.
Give greeting cards to the three men of the Empire.

That's what we came up with to congratulate the men.
There are three cards which we should give them. There all sorts of fine words and wishes. Rysina herself accepted the text! When I first heard, - I've been touched. And then! We, men are very pleasant too, to hear all the nice words. In addition, holder of the title "Defender of the Motherland" is of great confidence and it is easier for him to earn a reputation.
Come back when you complete this task, and I'll give you another one.
And more. In carrying out these tasks, you can increase your reputation with the "Spring Committee." It was established recently, specifically for these holidays.

My mother praised me once for fighting with a neighbor.
That's when I heard kind words from her, I immediately realized that I would not be just a Orc, i will be the most important! And you look - who I am now! Commander!
So to praise the men not only pleasant but also useful.

Good!
I have another task. Can you help?
Yes, almost forgot! Have a look at the Old Square for Martha Convolutina. She as well has a holiday mission for you.
Give red carnations for the tree men of the Empire.

That's what we came up with congratulations for men.
Flowers! Red carnations.
When I first heard, I made a wry face. Cool if it would be a new axe presented. Nice. But flowers?
But Yasker looked at me closely and said: "It's not a gift it's the attention that's important!" And I immediately realized he was right! Axe you should get in a battle! And the flowers... If you get - it means they think about you. Nice... Immediately you feel female attention.
I think you know what to do. Three carnations - three men.
Come back when complete this task, and i will give you another one.
And more. In carrying out these tasks, you can increase your reputation with the "Spring Committee." It was established recently, specifically for these holidays.

I've got flowers presented to me too.Dogrose the Forester, herbal trainer...
Does it mean anything?

Cool!
Let's do a new task.
Yes, almost forgot! Have a look at the Old Square for Martha Convolutina. She as well has a holiday mission for you.
Give the invitation to the three men of the Empire.

That's what we came up with congratulations on the men.
Gifts! I proposed it. Everyone loves to receive gifts, right?
I'll give you three invitations. Distribute them to three men. With this invitation, they can come to the Spring Committee and take a gift from the trunk. Cool! I feel like Santa Claus!
Come back when you complete this task, and I can give you another one.
In carrying out these tasks, you can increase your reputation with the "Spring Committee." It was established recently, specifically for these holidays.
There are a lot of things in this chest. Men would be very happy!

Excellent!
So are you ready for a new task.
Yes, almost forgot!Have a look at the Old Square for Martha Convolutina. She as well has a holiday mission for you.
Using a cosmetics set you should apply 10 times without damaging your makeup. When the task is successfully completed inform Martha Convolutina.

Hello.
Listen, I'll tell you honestly that this spring holiday - is a good chance for us, women.
War is going, men think more about the battles, mining and glory. And very little about our lives with them! And these days - is an excellent opportunity to change this situation.
That's why, my dear, we must be fully armed. And what is the main weapon of women?
Right! Rysina does understand it well. That's why, the Committee carefully shook smugglers, and now we have a part of smugglers elf cosmetics.
I can give you no more than 10 boxes! You should use it wisely! If you overdo it, then everything will collapse! You would scare a man, instead of getting his attention.
Well, will you'll take?
If we can make a good make-up, using all 10 sets of cosmetics, Spring Committee will be very grateful to you.

Why Spring Committee?
Simple logic! If you have a good make up the man will fall in love with you and the demographic problem will be fixed.See?
State business!

You did it!
Now all the guys are yours! They are now going to begin to fall at your feet.
Oh, how nice!
Shoot the Arrows of Passion at five Orcs, Xadaganians, Arisen, Aoidos and Imperial Pridens then return to Lyubov Serdechkina in Nezebgrad.

Nobody should stay aside during the Love Festival! I'm asking you to take care of your beloved ones and show them your feelings. Find Arrows of Passion among the trophies you loot from fallen enemies and hit five Orcs, Xadaganians, Zem Arisen, and Imperial Pridens with these arrows. Be sure I will reward you.
Great! Remember that your love will return to you hundredfold!
Find another player blinded by love and give them a Gift of Pure Love, or give a Gift of True Love to Lyubov Serdechkina to get rid of the love blindness.

Oh, what a bad luck! You are captured by a fatal passion. It happens when an arrow of passion strikes deep into your heart, causing strong emotions that paralyze your ability to see, hear or even think... You are blinded by love.Here, take this Gift of Pure Love and present it to one who was blinded by love too, just like you. It will help you to understand that careless love is blind and dangerous.
I wish someone gave me a Gift of True Love! Sometimes I regret that I'm not loveblinded.
Blind love is foolish... but still attractive!
Now you should see the difference between true love and fatal passion, which ruined life of many beautiful girls and boys...
Shoot the Arrows of Passion at five Kanians, Elves, Gibberlings, Aoidos and League Pridens, and return to Lyubov Serdechkina in Nezebgrad.

The worst enemies may become best friends during the Love Festival, because true love knows no barriers. You can see it yourself!
Obtain Arrows of Passion and strike League citizens with them. May your arrows strike love right in their hearts!
Great! Remember that your love will return to you hundredfold!
Shoot the Arrows of Passion into five orcs, Xadaganians, Zems, Aoidos, and Imperial Pridens.

Arrows of Passion will help you share your feelings with others. Find five Arrows of Passion and hit those of Orcs, Xadaganians, Arisen, Aoidos or Imperial Pridens who is worth your care and attention.
Both you and your target will receive a Gift of Admiration for each arrow, and it will be the first step to great and pure love!
Great! Remember that your love will return to you hundredfold!

Gather 3 Gifts of Admiration by shooting Arrows of Passion at monsters and other characters and return to Lyubov Serdechkina in Nezebgrad.

Characters of the opposite faction do not count.

Can you feel the flame of love smoldering in your heart? It depends on you if it is going to grow into a fire of passion, turn into a cozy family hearth or die out, leaving only bitter ashes of disappointment!
Today is Love Festival day and you have a great opportunity to understand your feelings, feel the love and share it. Arrows of Passion will help you with that. You can gather these arrows from the fallen enemies. Their magical power will melt even the most hardened hearts of either warriors, adventurers or monsters!
Now go and shoot three arrows at your enemies, defeat them, and receive Gifts of Admiration. They will appear among your Valuables right away. You will also get them if you just shoot other citizens of the Empire!
Love thy enemy! After all, your enemies are just reflection of what you cannot admit in yourself. Accept what you are, and love will replace all your feuds!
Read the card to your spouse.

Have you found your couple yet? Today is the best day of the year to find one, and if you already did, use this day to show your other half how much you love them.

This card has a love poem printed on it. Fight enemies, shot with Arrows of Passion, to obtain more cards. During this event, love poetry carry a secret power: reading a poem to the one you are in love with will grant you gifts of Love. The more cards you read, the more generous gifts Love will give you!
See, how wonderful love is! May your love last forever and never die!

If you have any souvenirs or decorations you don't need, don't hesitate to return them to me! Bring me Heart or Star Bunny Ears, a Flower Garland, Bunny or Cat Ears, a Firefly mask, a Gift of Love, a Patterned Shirt of the Amorous or Desire or Passion underwear, and I will trade them for Gifts of Admiration!
h: Exchange your souvenirs for Gifts of Admiration

t: I'd love to trade, but you don't have anything that I'd accept! Bring me Heart or Star Bunny Ears, a Flower Garland, Bunny or Cat Ears, a Firefly mask, a Gift of Love, a Patterned Shirt of the Amorous or Desire or Passion underwear, and I will trade them for Gifts of Admiration!
h: Exchange your souvenirs for Gifts of Admiration

t: How did you manage to lose such a precious item? Fine, fine, here's your loss. Don't lose it ever again!
Defeat the toughest opponent on an Astral allod of the current stage and receive the reward form Zinaida Krichalkina.

Fragments of memories... Vague images... Unknown faces and indistinct words... Someone asked you something. But who? And when?
The world doesn't stand still. Everything changes, the Astral devours the land, thoughts dissolve in the depths of memory. This request could have been important or minor, but the world has changed, and it doesn't matter now.
The only thing you can do is forget about it and continue your adventures.
Old memories no longer disturb you. Do not look back into the past, or you will miss your glorious future!
Build your own Astral Ship and talk to the portal Keeper Lenora Kuzina to get acceptance for a captain portal.

Beautiful portal! Recently built, and I'm the keeper!
With this portal captains of Astral ships immediately can get into port and go sail!
Are you the captain already? No? Then I'm sorry, for you this portal is closed. When you build your own ship - come back. We are pleased to open it for you.
More ships - more captains. And more clients for me!
So, now you are a captain as well! That mean that the portal is open for you, Come in!
Raise your reputation to Respected with the Imperial Crafters' Guild or the Imperial Suppliers' Guild and obtain an Artisans' Permit. Then return to Yuri Kavelin to become a Master Artisan.

Do you want to learn a second profession?

While most do not have the mental capacity to learn the intricacies of more than one profession, it is possible to do. For this reason, only those who have proven their mastery over their first profession will be allowed to train in a second.

When your reputation with the Nezebgrad Artisans' Guild is high enough, then Oleg Lukashin will sell you a permit to learn a second profession. After you get the document you should come to me and I'll immediately register you as a Master Artisan with permission to learn a second profession.

All clear? Good, I'll be waiting for you here if you get approved.
It is not easy to become a Master Artisan, but it's definitely worth the effort.

Excellent. This paper is a proof of your tenacity and perseverance! These qualities and distinguish real masters from all of the other artisans.
Remember, you're not like everyone else. Hold your head high!
Ask Pepper the Saltie about Best Friends.
Do you have a real friend? Not just a friend, but someone who you can trust your life with? Listen, I will tell you about a rite that will bind you.
Being best friends is a big deal. What to start with?.. Oh, I know - you ask your questions!
This is all about Friendship Rite. I hope you can make good use of it.
Make an embroidered wallet, a tin glass-holder, a decorated cane or an embroidered shawl and bring them to Victor Gvozdin.

All paths are open to the youth! Our guild accepts anyone who can demonstrate some degree of skill. But you'll have to work hard to earn the respect of your colleagues and gain access to privileges and benefits.

The achievements of our national economy are too numerous to mention at once. We can make sharp blades, strong armor, and durable boots. Yet to demonstrate our skill, we craft items that are useless but extremely hard to make. Blacksmiths boast of their glass holders, leatherworkers brag about their wallets, tailors exhibit their shawls and weaponsmiths show off their canes. Are you skilled enough to make one of those? If so, bring it to me, and I'll witness your first step to recognition.
Of course, that's child's play, not serious items. But if they allow a craftsman to demonstrate his skill, then they are useful too, right?

Not bad at all. Aye, this is the work of a true master. And now, look what I'll do to it!
Relax... This is tradition: make a perfect item, then break it and trample it like some worthless junk made by an apprentice. We do it to keep ourselves from growing arrogant and thinking we have nothing to learn. You can proceed without me. Create and destroy your creation to remind yourself and others: you are never good enough to stop learning. Craft ever more sophisticated and beautiful things: from an embroidered wallet to an exquisite one, from a tin glass-holder to a gilded one. That's the only way to earn respect of the masters!
Synthesize 20 vials of volatile phlogiston and bring them to Victor Gvozdin.

All paths are open to the youth! Our guild accepts anyone who can demonstrate some degree of skill. But you will have to work hard to earn the respect of your colleagues and gain access to privileges and benefits.

An alchemist has lots of formulas in his notepad, including both poisons and medicines. Yet the ultimate proof of mastery is a substance that has not been utilized by our national economy so far: phlogiston, aka thermogen. Isolating this elusive fluid and confining it into a flask - that's a task for a true virtuoso! If you want to earn respect of your colleagues - bring me 20 vials of volatile phlogiston.
Maybe one day we'll figure out how we can use that substance too. For now, we'll keep practicing.

Not bad, not bad. I see you can handle the retort. Proceed on your own. Synthesize a couple dozen vials and let the phlogiston out in public. That will earn you more respect from your colleagues. Yet the further you proceed, the higher the bar is raised. Only newbies brag about volatile phlogiston. To surprise veteran craftsmen, you need strong or even concentrated phlogiston.
Speak with the three Council informers - Hammerblow the Fierce, Yaver Mbizi, and Lev Ragulin. Inform Council agent Pavel Nevolin of the results.

There's also another matter.
You know, in a big city like Nezebgrad there are plenty of rumors going around. Some of them are started by the City Council itself, sure, but there are also rumors we've had nothing to do with. Those need to be investigated.
Usually they're not worth a damn. Take, for instance, the story about the Rat Man. We looked into it, trying to find out what was going on... Eventually, we found him. Turned out it's a regular Xadaganian guy who was a little crazy. He thought he was a superhero, so he got himself a tight suit and started running around the sewers. Poor guy!
And now there's this gossip about some Temptress. That she was seen here and there, confusing men and disturbing their daily lives. This is unacceptable! So we've got to sort this out. Let's do this - you go talk to the City Council's three informers. You'll find Hammerblow the Fierce in the Old Square, Yaver Mbizi at the Triumphal Arch, and Lev Ragulin in the Hadron Quarter. I believe you've already meet them, hehe...

Temptress... Well, well!
We'll see what troubles will befall our heads...

So, the construction area on the Old Square... That's where the winged Temptress was seen...
Let's work on that!
In the construction area of Old Square, seek out the Temptress.

Here's what we'll do!
You head to the UNOP construction area and find this Temptress and... Yes, interrogate her!
I have no doubt that your impeccable moral values will ensure that everything is handled appropriately!

Oh dear! Help! Save me! They're killing me!
Oh my... You're not going to kill me? You just want to talk?
To tell you the truth, I'm not used to being treated like that...
Okay then... Let's talk.
Discover Xadaganian clothes for little Elven by looking in the houses on the Old and bring the taking to the Temptress

My name...

I don't want to say it. To bring shame on the name of the renowned Elven House? Never! Just call me Zizi. I'm used to it...

Our ship was captured by the Imperial patrol. My companions died, but my fate was different.

You probably believe in the infallibility of your leaders. It's not true. Me and several other girls were forced to dance for high-ranking Imperial officials in some hellhole for years! Yes, there's a place like that in this cursed city. The patrons call it the Bunker.

I want to escape from this damn city. But looking like this... It will be hard. I need clothes. Xadaganian clothes. Where do I get them? I'd check the nearby houses: chests, closets, drawers. You'll find something, I'm sure.

Everything will work, even dirty and worn. Just need not to be naked.
And run away... Run!

Ugh, how can you wear something like this...?

Gah, I'll have to put it on! There's no other way.

Well, I should thank you... Here's the money I was able to get!
Bring Valery Comissarina a Bottle of Champagne to carry out a divorce.

Well, listen carefully.
You want to divorce but your spouse won't give consent? I can help you out. We can do it quickly, League-style, so to say.
Just bring me a Bottle of Champagne from the Boutique and you are free.
Agreed?

Next time don't be in a rush when you decide to register a marriage, otherwise you'll waste your money again.
Done! Congratulations. You are free again! You are divorced.
Meet with Puwa the Crafty in the Bort Quarter.

Stop! Why don't you have your patronage? What an outrage! The Imperial Survivor does not have their patronage! How did the City Council miss this?
Do you know anything about the Twelve Great Martyrs? Alright, time for a brief excursion into history... The Great Mages managed to stop the destruction of the world during the Great Cataclysm by learning to hold back the Astral. It wasn't easy - twelve of the Great Mages died.
After the Great Cataclysm it was revealed that the Astral has twelve magical tides. Each of those has its own particular power and influence. It has been suggested that the source of this power comes from the twelve Great Mages that gave their lives during the Great Cataclysm.
The souls of the Great Mages are immortal you know - they can even withstand the Astral. Tensess is proof of this. This theory has its opponents but most of the inhabitants believe in this theory and attempt to get the patronage of one of the Great Mages, known as the Twelve Great Martyrs.
There is a shaman named Puwa the Crafty that can help you gain your patronage. You can find her in the Bort Quarter. After a quick ceremony you should be able to discover new strength.
I'm Puwa! Did you come to get your patronage too? Alright, let's begin!
Meet Vlad Astralin at the Nezebgrad port.

Very few heroes make it to the fifth level of Patronage, or even get close to it.

The ship of Vlad Astralin has just moored in the port. He is one of the Free Traders, but he's been to every corner of Sarnaut in his days. They say, he knows the secret of the fifth level of Patronage, but he won't just share it with any stranger. And he definitely won't do it for free. He's a trader, after all!

Talk to him. I'm sure he will share his knowledge with you!

- Well-wisher

Fifth level, is it? You've come to the right place.

Take these Holy Symbols, you will need them. And since anybody and everybody and Nezebgrad speaks so well of you, I will also give you a small personal present - a gift coupon for a Patronage Box.

Let me tell you how it works.
Give 10,000 Holy Symbols to Vlad Astralin to get a Sacred Rune.

Do you want to get the fifth level of Patronage?
Free Traders can help you. Now I will tell you what to do.
First of all, and this is important - you must already have the fourth level of Patronage.
Secondly, you must be at least level 40.
Thirdly, visit the Boutique. A new item is sold there called Patronage Box. There are several Holy Symbols in every chest. Bring me 10,000 of them and I will give you the Sacred Rune. It will grant you access to an island where exciting adventure is waiting for you. Complete all trials there, and you will obtain the fifth level of Patronage.
Believe me, the fifth level of Patronage is worth every effort spent!

Excellent!
The Sacred Rune is yours.
Collect 10,000 Holy Symbols and speak to Vlad Astralin to get a Sacred Rune.

Do you want to get the fifth level of Patronage?
Free Traders can help you. Now I will tell you what to do.
First of all, and this is important - you must already have the fourth level of Patronage.
Secondly, you must be at least level 30.
Thirdly, visit the Boutique. A new item is sold there called Patronage Box. There are several Holy Symbols in every chest. Bring me 10,000 of them and I will give you the Sacred Rune. It will grant you access to an island where exciting adventure is waiting for you. Complete all trials there, and you will obtain the fifth level of Patronage.
And keep in mind that you can combine 100 Holy Symbols to activate the fifth level of Patronage temporarily.
Believe me, the fifth level of Patronage is worth every effort spent!

Excellent!
The Sacred Rune is yours.
Bring the Sacred Rune to Vlad Astralin to travel to the Forgotten Temple and get the fifth level of Patronage.

Do you have the Sacred Rune?
Few adventurers can boast the fifth level of Patronage. You must be extremely lucky to find the Forgotten Temple Isle where Agrus the Great Dragon lives. If you come to an agreement with him, he will reward you with the next level of Patronage.
But first you have to get to the island. Bring me the Sacred Rune and I will send you to the adventures in the Forgotten Temple!
You are very close to obtaining the new level of Patronage. Bring me the Sacred Rune to make the first step!

Great!
Using the power of the Rune I will send you to visit the Great Dragon.
Tell me when you are ready to go.
Use the coupon to purchase a Patronage Box at the Boutique, open it and combine 100 Holy Symbols. Report to Vlad Astralin in Nezebgrad port.

Holy Symbols are representations of faith. The more you possess, the more powerful they are. If you keep collecting them, one day they will shine as brightly as the eyes of thousands devout Imperial warriors! And that kind of power can move mountains, mark my words.

Collect 10,000 Holy Symbols, and the fifth level of Patronage will be forever yours. But there is a way to try it out just for two hours. It will only take 100 Holy Symbols. You already have 90. With this coupon I gave you, you can obtain a Patronage Box from the Boutique, which will additionally grant you certain amount of symbols.

Try it! You will see for yourself all the possibilities of the fifth Patronage level.

Can you feel it? Can you feel the power filling you up? I can see that you do. Be proud of yourself - the fifth Patronage level is not something anyone can experience.

Now that you have this power, try it in action. Remember, you only have two hours. If you want to possess it permanently, collect 10,000 Holy Symbols and come back again. We will set out on an unforgettable journey.
Scatter the Handful of Astral Dust, defeat the Miserable Demon Mage, and report to Puwa the Crafty.

Many people passed through me. Everybody needs Patron's powers.
Here is the place for the ceremony. What's important? Astral should be near. Of course, we could arrange everything on shore. But it has been decided that it is convenient. Mana-station next door. And the mana we have from what? Right! From the Astral. So, here is alright.
Don't worry! Succeed. If you're not going to yawn.
Look what should be done.
You take this here Astral dust and dispel it by wind in a special place. Right after this fence.
Astral winds will blow. Just do not be afraid, stand and wait! Let them... it... blew. And you stay and listen.
Twelve Great Martyrs will begin talking to you. They will check you out and decide who prefers you. What is more suitable to you.
Well, then the most interesting. Astral demon appears to kill you, so you don't get the power. What do you need to do?
Kill the demon. Exactly!
That's all.
If you do everything right you will get the power and power never will be enough!

From now on the power of your Martyr will be with you. You can use Martyr's Salvation ability to restore your strength after combat using drops of mirra that I give you. When you spend all of them, you will be able to buy more from Servants of Light.
Who knows, maybe you will have the honor to get the higher ranks of Patronage and your power will increase.
Meet with Shaman Fors Brains near the Bort Quarter, to undergo the rite for Patronage.

Attention, Imperial Citizens!
Be aware that the first level of Patronage can now be obtained in Nezebgrad! All citizens who don't know their Martyr yet, should pay a visit to Power the Crafty at the Bort Quarter.
I repeat...

Next!
Yeah, did you come for power as well?
I'm Power! That's what I'm called. Perhaps because I'm helping to find protection or maybe because I'm bending a horseshoe with my arms.
Okay, let's not be distracted!
Take part in May celebration in Nezebgrad.

This is the Scroll of Honor that expresses gratitude of the Empire in a perfect bureaucratese. An official invitation to the celebrations in Nezebgrad is attached to it. It says, Yasker himself will take part, and it promises colorful fireworks... Hm, looks like it's worth visiting.
To go or not to go, that is the question.
That was a great firework! One of a kind! Our fireworks are the best in Sarnaut! Come again, we'll make more!
Use the brazier and other ingredients to cook meat.

You know how much citizens of the Empire love barbecue. You should also know that history of this popular dish traces back into Ancient Xadagan, when Nezeb only began to rule the Empire. What? Orcs invented barbecue, you said?
Ah well, I admit, that's true. I should make you sign a non-disclosure agreement on this case! Now let's get back to the barbecue and, particularly, meat that is needed to cook it.
This here is Timur Kefirin, top supplier of meat and wood in the Empire. You may purchase from him all you need for barbecue and join the feast, cook your own dish! More ingredients can be found in gifts.
As soon as the dish is ready, eat it while it's hot. Or invite a friend to your table! After you've finished, come back to me.
There are so many good cooks in the Empire! This delicious smell makes me hungrier and hungrier! I think I'll have to order a new uniform...
Delicious, right? I wonder how orcs could cook something like this. Eat up, eat every day, and you will be strong enough to fight the Imperial enemy!
Equip the banner, gather 15 Proofs of Exploit and listen to Yasker's speech, then return to Maya Styagina in Nezebgrad.

Special Committee's decree instructs each hero of the Empire to raise the Imperial Banner at the battlefield, in order to mortify and frighten the enemy. You may receive the Banner from the official in charge - Timur Kefirin, that is. You should also bring back to me proofs of your exploits, performed under the Banner. As soon as you bring enough, you will receive a reward!
Don't forget to maintain your posture, while the Banner is up! Back straight, shoulders square, chin up! Imperial Soldier! That has a proud sound!
All these days our leader and father of the nation, Great Yasker, will take part in the celebrations, in person! Everyone must be present! To motivate you further, every guest of the ceremony will receive an honorary gift. Special guests will receive special gifts!
I can see no proof, comrade. This lack of eagerness worries me.
On behalf of the Committee, I commend you for supporting the image of the Empire and striking its enemies! Don't forget to come back from time to time.

Attention, attention, citizens and heroes of the Empire! Yasker orders to start celebration of the May Holiday, starting today! The celebration will last for a month. All citizens are required to participate in holiday events!

Meet Maya Styagina for special quests and honorable rewards!

I repeat...
Don't you know? Hurry to Maya Styagina! The celebrations won't last forever!
Happy spring, comrade! I hope you will enjoy the organized celebrations! We all worked hard on it!
Talk to a representative of the Tycoon Club in Nezebgrad bank to learn about the new program.

Good day! Have you heard of a new recruitment order aimed to bring new heroes to Sarnaut? Free Traders will give you fantastic rewards for inviting a friend into our world!
Learn more about it from Angelica Berezkina of the Free Traders.
Do you want to learn about the new campaign?
Now you know everything. Find yourself some followers, grow them into real soldiers and get your reward!
Talk to a representative of the Tycoon Club in Nezebgrad bank to learn about the new program.

Good day! Have you heard of a new recruitment order aimed to bring new heroes to Sarnaut? Free Traders will give you fantastic rewards for inviting a friend into our world!
Learn more about it from Angelica Berezkina of the Free Traders.
Have you heard of the new campaign sponsored by the Tycoon Club to support defenders of Sarnaut?
Now you know everything. Find yourself some followers, grow them into real soldiers and get your reward!
Ask Wire the Wily about the Kingdom of Nature.

We wardens have many secrets. Even our own have to prove themselves before they are let into some of them. You've convinced me, so listen to me carefully.
We have a special place of our own in the world. With no mana pipelines, no tourists - it's only you and Mother Nature. This place is called the Kingdom of Nature. It's time for you to visit this sacred place.
I've already sent word to Wire the Wily. Go straight to her, she'll explain everything. And be sure to keep your mouth shut about it!
I think, it's too early yet to let you into Kingdom of Nature. But if Galewind trusts in you, I'll teach you what to do. Listen up.
Well, I've shown you the way. Go to the Kingdom of Nature and explore our history. But beware: if you make a mess there or tell anyone about it, you'll have both Galewind and me to answer to!
Visit four Holiday Committee Officials in Nezebgrad and take their advice for a gallant chevalier.

Is there anything difficult in meeting someone and falling in love? Building a relationship can be a real challenge. Good thing is that there always will be old folks to pass on some useful advice.
I may not be so handsome but I know what ladies want. Ladies like might and power, they just don't really need all these hearts-and-flowers garbage. Show her your strength, carry her in your arms and hold her tight. Then she'll follow you to the ends of the world!
I know it for sure, you must show her who is the boss! Anyway, you better ask our Holiday Committee Officials for some other tips.
Remember, ladies are fragile and should be treated with love and care!
Visit four Holiday Committee Officials in Nezebgrad and take their advice for a beautiful lady.

Is there anything difficult in meeting someone and falling in love? Building a relationship can be a real challenge. If you want to charm a young man, be delicate and tender, make him feel he's protecting you. You can put your head on his shoulder and sigh as if you're tired... Then he'll follow you to the ends of the world!
You probably know these guiles better than me. However, go ask our Holiday Committee Officials for some other tips!
Do not tickle him when you're in his arms! It's not funny. Besides, it can be dangerous!
Use the Ancient Megaphone to call for ZIT workers, helping Sarang Nar realize which world he belongs to.

What is this place? Where am I? Who are you?
I remember... I was sick... Hurt... Dying. Then... Death! Am I resurrected?
Can anybody explain me what is going on here?!
Look, I have this Ancient Megaphone with me. Use it to call for help. Shout out loudly - someone will hear you and come to my aid.

I don't understand...
Horrible world. Grass is faded, trees are small...
Oh, it seems my fellows will help me to sort it out. Thank you. This megaphones is a great thing. Do they still exist? I'm sure you can find some in the Boutique. They are very helpful.
Complete Valery Comissarina's objectives in order to carry out your divorce.

What? Are you divorcing?!
But why?! Did you fall from the XAES? You are making my statistics worse! Marriages registered in the Empire are the strongest marriages in the world! Yasker himself said that! Do you disagree with him?
Oh, you...
Well! I will tell you what should be done.
First, you must buy Divorce Papers from me and read them aloud here, in front of me, to your spouse.
If he or she agrees to divorce, you should sign them and you will be divorced.
That is it. I hope you never complete this task!

A-a-a! Are you divorcing?
It is against the principles of Empire!

I need to fulfill my duty.
In the name of the Great Empire, I free you from matrimonial obligations.
Done! You are free.
Complete Valery Comissarina's objectives to register your marriage.

Do you want to get married? Do you want to create a strong family unit in society? Good for you. Here is a guide on how to do it.
First of all, you must buy Wedding Rings and Wedding Dress from the Boutique. Secondly, your future spouse must put on the Wedding Dress and appear before me. As you initiated the wedding, you must have 10 gold coins to pay the marriage tax. To register your marriage, both of you must be over level 18. You cannot register a marriage with a character of the same gender.
If you meet these requirements you may propose to your future spouse. You will need Wedding Rings; one of them will be presented to your fiance!
As soon as he or she receives the ring it should be put on to confirm their consent to get married.
Is everything clear?

In the name of the Great Empire and in accordance with the decree of the Great Mage Yasker which orders the encouragement of marriage, I pronounce you man and wife!
May your life be happy and prosperous!
Hurrah!
Bring the Universal Core Morpher to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters.

Magical runes, engraved on this plate of strange metal, read that this item contains a great power, able to turn a wizard into a warrior, and a bandit into a righteous man... You should show this thing to Goblin Banker!
Good afternoon! How can I help you?

What's that? Let me see.

Wow! It is a Universal Core Morpher - a very rare thing! I will gladly exchange it for any other Core Morpher. Choose wisely!
Bring Shards of the Tears of the Dragon to Anna Kavelina in Novograd.
This is a curious thing... It looks like a slightly opaque crystal, filled with an incredibly strong magic. Better show it to someone who understands.
What can I help you with?

These are tears of the Dragon! They are so large, so rare!..

Dragons were the Keepers of Sarnaut, who died out very long ago. The legends say that the dragons used to mourn their fallen comrades. Their tears reached the ground to freeze into crystals, filled with magic. I shouldn’t know if this is true or not, but what I do know is that they are very useful in combat.

If you have Tears of the Dragon in your locket, your blows and spells will deal much higher damage - at the expense of magic, released from the Tears. As soon as a tear runs out of magic, it burns to ashes. Experienced heroes always carry spare Tears on them.

The purer the tear, the more magic it conceals. I will provide you with a few, but in the future you will have to take care about it yourself.
Order Maurice de Ardeur to start building an astral ship, wait until the construction is complete and talk to the Glowy Family in the astral hangar.

The Astral is deadly to any matter. It dissolves anything it touches without a trace - people, objects, even entire allods! For many years the only way to move between the allods was via portals. It was only recently that the gibberlings have discovered the secret of meteorite iron. Thanks to this discovery the gibberlings have become the best travelers in the world and distinguished themselves amongst the League's subjects.
The fact is meteorite iron can repel the Astral. Now our ships have a plating that contains extra small particles of meteorite iron, which allows them to plow through the deadly Astral just as easily as boats sail on river waters. And now you have a chance to acquire an astral ship and become a true astral captain.
If you have 1500 gold coins, I will order a new ship to be built right away - the job will be done in 10 days. When the construction is complete, talk to the ship masters, the Glowy Family, in the astral hangar.
We won't be able to help you until your ship has been built.
Wow, what a beautiful ship you've got! Reliable, robust and fast... A dream of a ship!
Excellent! Perfect! I'll prepare your ship in 5 minutes.
h: Give away the License and 1500 gold to receive an Astral Ship
Give away the License and 1500 gold to receive an Astral Ship

t: What do you want to know?
Congratulations! Your ship is ready to fly.
h: We finally finished the job! You are now the proud owner of an Astral ship.

t: I am happy to give you a progress report. If you'd like to speed things along, ask me about the work being done on your ship.
h: Ask about your ship's construction progress

t: Perfect! I'll make arrangements to start the construction right away. It's quite a long process, but I can tell you how to speed it up.
h: Pay 1500 gold to start the construction of your ship.
Pay 1500 gold to start the construction of your ship.

t: Bring a League Shipbuilder's License to Maurice de Ardeur in the Novograd Port.
After you bring a League Shipbuilder's License to Maurice de Ardeur in the Novograd Port and pay 1500 Gold, you will be able to buy an Astral Ship right away!
If you happen to find a League Shipbuilder's License, I will give you a completed Astral ship right away!
Oh, my! I never thought I'd live to see the day when one of these would show up. Congratulations - now you can receive your Astral ship!
Take a League Shipbuilder's License to Maurice de Ardeur in the Novograd Port.
If you bring a League Shipbuilder's License to Maurice de Ardeur in the Novograd Port, you will receive a completed Astral Ship right away!
If you happen to find a League Shipbuilder's License, I will give you a completed Astral ship right away!

Congratulations!
There are very few in the world as lucky as you.
Accept Maurice de Ardeur's offer to start the construction.

What’s it going to be now? I can’t wait to get to the Far Astral! I wonder what goes on there, what monsters, what allods... New anomalies, unexplored lands! Damned Tep, why did he have to step out with his stupid mechanoids at this moment?

Haven’t you got an astral ship yet? Hurry to your Astral academy to see Maurice de Ardeur. Both League and Empire decorated a whole allod with their ships’ wreckage, so all of us will have to create a new fleet! New ships, new crews, new captain... See which way the astral flee jumps? Right. So, the new ship is what you need, and all the Astral treasures are yours!
Alright, now we can begin building your ship. It will take us thirty three days to complete this on our own, but remember that you can always boost the process.
